column3: Kuroneko Route · Procurement of Necessary Supplies
Could you lend me your laptop?
Why? Don't you have a desktop? The one Saori gave you.
You should be able to understand my feelings as a 'sister-moe' enthusiast. I want to play sister-related games on my sister's laptop.
Hey! Why did you close the door?!
Eh? That's weird... My secret plan has...
I'm sorry! I just lied to you! Please open the door! Give me another chance!
I need your laptop to help Kuroneko! Although I can't really tell you why -- Please, lend it to me!
...Although I don't know what you're doing...
Kirino... I can understand your feelings without you telling me.
